sources.note: Densely developed Census settlement units; may cross state and municipal boundaries. Published POP100 and AREALAND retained. Display polygons generalized by the official query; values are not recomputed from them.

sources.title: U.S. Census · urban and rural definitions
sources.note: An urban area is not a city or a metropolitan statistical area. At least 2,000 housing units or 5,000 people, with additional delineation rules.

limitations: These are densely developed Census urban areas, not municipal cities, counties or metropolitan statistical areas.
Urban areas may cross state and municipal boundaries. The map keeps the native settlement boundary.
Population is from the 2020 Census and is not a current estimate.
Density is population divided by published land area; simplified display geometry is not used to recompute it.
These observations do not measure transportation demand, deprivation, health or service quality.
